# The Governor's Inn

> The Governor's Inn is a restaurant and hotel on the historic Spaulding estate at 78 Wakefield Street, Rochester, NH 03867, the estate of brothers Huntley and Rolland Spaulding, both Governors of New Hampshire, run by the Ejarque family since 1992. Spaulding Steak & Ale serves dinner Tuesday through Saturday from 4 PM and Sunday brunch 8 AM to 2 PM. The inn has twenty guest rooms with breakfast included, hosts weddings and events across the estate, runs The Garage beer garden May through October, and stages live music five nights a week. Phone: (603) 332-0107.

## Dine

- [Spaulding Steak & Ale menu and takeout via Toast](https://www.toasttab.com/local/order/spaulding-steak-ale-78-wakefield-st): flame-broiled steaks, chicken, and fresh seafood, dinner Tuesday to Saturday from 4 PM with happy hour, Sunday brunch 8 to 2, takeout every night the restaurant is open.
- [Dining at The Governor's Inn](https://www.governorsinn.com/#dine): two restaurants on one estate, Spaulding Steak & Ale inside and The Garage beer garden out back, plus trivia Tuesdays at 6:30 PM and APA billiards Friday and Saturday 6 to 10 PM.

## Stay

- [Book a room online](https://apps.gracesoft.com/PMS/EasyWebRez/roomdetails/1042): twenty original guest rooms, each with private bath, air conditioning, cable, free local calls, and high-speed wireless, continental-plus breakfast included.
- [Rooms at The Governor's Inn](https://www.governorsinn.com/#stay): details on staying overnight at the inn in Rochester, NH.

## Weddings and events

- [Weddings at The Governor's Inn](https://www.governorsinn.com/weddings.html): the dedicated weddings and events page, garden ceremonies at the gazebo, receptions under the tented courtyard or in the ballroom, rehearsal dinners, showers, celebrations of life, business and fundraiser events, and rooms for wedding guests. Tours by phone: (603) 332-0107.
- [Weddings and events on the Spaulding estate](https://www.governorsinn.com/#events): ceremonies in the gardens at the gazebo, receptions under the tented courtyard or in the ballroom, plus rehearsal dinners, showers, celebrations of life, and business events. Inquiries: (603) 332-0107 or thegovernorsinn@gmail.com.

## Live music

- [Live music schedule](https://www.governorsinn.com/#music): five nights a week, free acoustic sets Wednesday and Thursday 6 to 9 PM at Spaulding Steak & Ale, live bands Friday and Saturday 7 to 10 PM at The Garage (May to October), Sunday concerts 5 to 8 PM, usually a $7 cover for weekend bands.
- [The Governor's Inn on Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/profile.php/?id=100069548921660): this week's confirmed acts and schedule changes.

## Visit

- [Location and hours](https://www.governorsinn.com/#visit): 78 Wakefield Street, Rochester, NH 03867, marked by the hanging Restaurant & Hotel sign. Phone (603) 332-0107, best 9 AM to 5 PM.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://www.governorsinn.com/#faq): hours, rooms, takeout, music cover charges, wedding inquiries, and directions.
